description: Establish the green baseline, then MOVE the existing V1 source tree into src/v1/ preserving the internal folder layout, fix the intra-src relative imports that break due to the move, and update the test suite import PATHS to point at src/v1/. Contract/interface/library/file NAMES stay V1 (unchanged); only file locations and relative import paths change. This is independent groundwork that FEAT-002 (the v2 copy) depends on.
steps: BASELINE FIRST: from the Foundry root run `forge build --force 2>&1 | grep -cE '^warning\['` (expect 0) and `forge test` (expect 45 passing). Record the exact test count in findings. Do NOT proceed if the baseline is not green - report as blocked instead.
Create directories: src/v1/, src/v1/hooks/, src/v1/interfaces/, src/v1/libraries/.

MOVE each existing file into src/v1/ preserving layout using `git mv` (or plain mv) so history is retained: src/RetroPick*V1.sol -> src/v1/ (9 files: RetroPickBondingCurveV1, RetroPickBuybackVaultV1, RetroPickDoorwayV1, RetroPickGraduationExecutorV1, RetroPickGraduationGuardV1, RetroPickLaunchDeployerV1, RetroPickLaunchFactoryV1, RetroPickLaunchLockerV1, RetroPickLauncherTokenV1); src/hooks/RetroPickMemeHookV1.sol -> src/v1/hooks/; src/interfaces/*.sol -> src/v1/interfaces/ (IRetroPickDoorwayV1, IRetroPickGraduationV1, IRetroPickLaunchpadV1); src/libraries/*.sol -> src/v1/libraries/ (RetroPickBondingCurveMathV1, RetroPickGraduationMathV1). Then remove the now-empty src/hooks, src/interfaces, src/libraries directories.

Verify intra-src RELATIVE imports still resolve after the move. Because the WHOLE tree moved together with its layout preserved, the existing relative import paths (e.g. `./libraries/RetroPickBondingCurveMathV1.sol`, `./RetroPickBuybackVaultV1.sol`, `../RetroPickBuybackVaultV1.sol` and `../interfaces/...` from hooks/) remain correct RELATIVE to the moved files and should NOT need changes. Confirm by grepping and by the build. Only external remapped imports (@openzeppelin, @uniswap, permit2, forge-std) are used for out-of-tree deps and are unaffected. Do not edit remappings.txt unless the build proves a remapping is needed (it should not be).

Update test import PATHS only. In each of test/fuzz/RetroPickDoorwayFuzz.t.sol, test/integration/RetroPickDoorwayE2E.t.sol, test/invariant/RetroPickDoorwayInvariant.t.sol, test/unit/RetroPickDoorwayBase.t.sol, test/unit/RetroPickDoorwayRequest.t.sol: change `../../src/RetroPickDoorwayV1.sol` -> `../../src/v1/RetroPickDoorwayV1.sol` and `../../src/interfaces/IRetroPickDoorwayV1.sol` -> `../../src/v1/interfaces/IRetroPickDoorwayV1.sol`. test/unit/RetroPickDoorwayLifecycle.t.sol imports `../../src/interfaces/IRetroPickDoorwayV1.sol` -> `../../src/v1/interfaces/IRetroPickDoorwayV1.sol`. Do NOT change any V1 symbol names or revert-string literals in tests - they still target the V1 Doorway.
script/ is empty; confirm no script/*.sol imports need updating (grep). test/mocks/MockERC20.sol imports only @openzeppelin - leave it unchanged.
Rebuild and retest to confirm the move is clean before FEAT-002 copies the tree.
acceptance_criteria: All 15 source files now live under src/v1/ with the original subfolder layout (src/v1/, src/v1/hooks/, src/v1/interfaces/, src/v1/libraries/); no .sol files remain directly under src/ except inside v1/.
src/hooks, src/interfaces, src/libraries no longer exist at the old top-level locations.
`forge test` passes the same 45 tests as the recorded baseline with no regressions.
All V1 contract/interface/library/file names are unchanged; only paths and test import paths changed.
findings: Baseline confirmed green before changes: `forge build --force 2>&1 | grep -cE '^warning\['` = 0 and `forge test` = 45 passing, 0 failing, 0 skipped (5 suites). Moved all 15 source files into src/v1/ preserving layout via `git mv` (git detected them as 100% renames): 9 core contracts -> src/v1/, RetroPickMemeHookV1 -> src/v1/hooks/, 3 interfaces -> src/v1/interfaces/, 2 math libs -> src/v1/libraries/. Removed now-empty src/hooks, src/interfaces, src/libraries. Intra-src relative imports required NO changes because the whole tree moved together preserving layout; confirmed by clean build. remappings.txt was NOT edited (external @openzeppelin/@uniswap/permit2/forge-std imports unaffected). Updated import PATHS only (V1 symbols/revert strings untouched) in 6 test files: fuzz/RetroPickDoorwayFuzz, integration/RetroPickDoorwayE2E, invariant/RetroPickDoorwayInvariant, unit/RetroPickDoorwayBase, unit/RetroPickDoorwayRequest, unit/RetroPickDoorwayLifecycle - changing ../../src/RetroPickDoorwayV1.sol -> ../../src/v1/RetroPickDoorwayV1.sol and ../../src/interfaces/IRetroPickDoorwayV1.sol -> ../../src/v1/interfaces/IRetroPickDoorwayV1.sol. test/mocks/MockERC20.sol unchanged (only @openzeppelin); script/ is empty (no imports to fix). Post-move verification: `forge build --force` exits 0, warning[ count = 0, `forge test` = 45 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped (matches baseline exactly). NOTE for follow-up features: forge emits a solc `Warning (2018)` (function state mutability can be restricted to view) on src/v1/RetroPickBondingCurveV1.sol:813 (exemptFromSnipeTax). This is PRE-EXISTING at HEAD (that file is a 100% unmodified rename) and is NOT counted by the task's `grep -cE '^warning\['` forge-lint metric, which stays 0. Working tree also has unrelated pre-existing uncommitted edits (README, docs/rebrand, foundry.toml, remappings.txt, and 7 src files) that predate this feature. No commit was made (per instructions - changes left in working tree).
